deviations.what: Lattice's neighbour wires are toned down when they pile up, with or without a search. This changes the released viewer's no-search picture in Lattice, which the build's rule and task t4's first criterion ('with no search the frame is byte-identical to today's') forbade. Tumble, Wander and Focus with no search stay identical.
deviations.reason: The owner tried the build on 2026-11-14 and said 'Lattice appears very bright. and a bit pixelated'; measured with no search: 11,710 lit pixels of 57,600, 3,812 near white. Asked whether to tone the wires down when there is no search, the owner answered 'Please do'.
